entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Showers turning to snow Sunday afternoon about the summit and may lower to 600 metres during Monday morning. Expect 3 to 6 cm about the summit with lesser amounts to 600 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers lowering to about 800 metres Sunday afternoon or evening, and to about 500 metres on Monday. Expect 2 to 4 cm about the summit with lesser amounts lower down.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Strong Wind Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Severe gale westerlies gusting 120 km/h in exposed places. Impact: Damage to trees, powerlines, and unsecured structures possible. Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low. Changes: Upgraded to Orange Warning.
